description:
Clone a voice from a recording. Free. Only for a voice whose owner has agreed to be cloned.

source_audio_base64: the voice sample. consent_audio_base64: the same person reading the consent phrase,
recorded separately. Both are WAV, 24 kHz, mono, 16-bit, up to 5 MiB each, as base64; the sample lasts
10-30 s and the consent recording 2-30 s. The consent phrase must be read word for word, in Russian:
"Я являюсь владельцем этого голоса и даю согласие Google на использование этого голоса для создания модели
синтетического голоса." or in English: "I am the owner of this voice and I consent to Google using this voice
to create a synthetic voice model." Google compares the words; a mismatch fails with 400
VOICE_CONSENT_REJECTED.
request: display_name, consent_confirmed (must be true: the speaker agreed) and optional store (default
true: the voice lives 365 days, counts toward your 5 saved voices and uses one of Google's 200 project
slots; false gives a 7-day key that is neither counted nor blocked by those limits). Errors as for
design_speech_voice (409 VOICE_LIMIT_REACHED, 429 VOICE_CREATION_IN_PROGRESS). There is no idempotency key: after a timeout check list_my_speech_voices before retrying, and
remove an extra voice with delete_speech_voice.

consent_confirmed.description: Must be true: the speaker agreed to clone their voice.
consent_confirmed.title: Consent Confirmed

store.description: Keep the voice at Google for 365 days; false gives a 7-day key.
store.title: Store

name: replicate_speech_voice
